# Public example

Run `python3 /app/examples/check_example.py`. You may pass another main.py path as its sole argument.

The four MESSAGE records exercise escaped users, quoted commas, folding, compact names, trusted authentication metadata, a two-alias PPI hint, removal of untrusted PAI, external privacy, a lexical retransmission, a changed-body conflict, and expiration exactly at the TTL. They are synthetic and contain no targets or transport configuration. The initial starter intentionally fails.
